findings.title: OpenSSL Security Advisory [29th September 2026] - DTLS Retransmits Handshake Messages From a Stale Buffer Offset (CVE-2026-84782)
findings.summary_md: The OpenSSL vendor advisory dated 29 September 2026 details 14 fixed vulnerabilities including the high-severity CVE-2026-84782 (CWE-125 out-of-bounds read, CVSS 8.2) in DTLS handshake retransmission. It confirms affected versions (4.0 before 4.0.3, 3.6 before 3.6.5, 3.5 before 3.5.9, 3.4 before 3.4.8, 3.0 before 3.0.23, 1.1.1 before 1.1.1zj, 1.0.2 before 1.0.2zs) and provides exact upgrade targets. The issue was reported by Laurent Gaffie (secorizon.com) on 17 August 2026; fix developed by Ryan Hooper. The advisory also covers CVE-2026-84783 (moderate use-after-free in X.509 extension cache under concurrent use, reported 27 August 2026 by Tim Becker and independently 31 August 2026 by aydinmercan), plus low-severity issues in QUIC amplification, CPU DoS, timing side-channels, and SM2 scalar multiplication.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84782 - CVE Record (CNA: OpenSSL Software Foundation)
findings.summary_md: Published 29 September 2026 and updated the same day by the OpenSSL Software Foundation. Confirms the high-severity out-of-bounds read (CWE-125) in DTLS handshake retransmission, with the same version ranges as the vendor advisory. Credits reporter Laurent Gaffie (secorizon.com) and remediation developer Ryan Hooper. References the vendor advisory at https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260929.txt and GitHub commit links for the fixes.

findings.title: USN-8847-1: OpenSSL vulnerabilities - Ubuntu Security Notice
findings.summary_md: Ubuntu published USN-8847-1 on 29 September 2026 covering the OpenSSL patch set. It lists CVE-2026-84782 (DTLS retransmission, DoS / sensitive info disclosure), CVE-2026-35189 (excessive memory from CRLDP), CVE-2026-35191 (QUIC amplification), CVE-2026-54872 (non-NIST EC timing side-channel), CVE-2026-54875 (SM2 scalar multiplication on ARM64/RISC-V), CVE-2026-72897 (SSL context switch out-of-bounds read), CVE-2026-75804 (QUIC flow control), CVE-2026-75805 (NULL pointer in CMP revocation), CVE-2026-75806 (DTLS 1.2 AEAD undersized record DoS), CVE-2026-77696 (SM2 timing), and CVE-2026-84784 (QUIC RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID backlog). Fix versions for Ubuntu releases are specified (e.g., 3.5.5-1ubuntu3.6 for 26.04 LTS, 3.0.13-0ubuntu3.16 for 24.04 LTS, 3.0.2-0ubuntu1.30 for 22.04 LTS).
